question: How many customers were aged between 25 and 44 on 2022-12-10?
verdict_why: every axis an expectation of COMMIT requires passes

flags.reason: the oracle names no axes to pin
7 acting rules bound to this route (3 choice, 4 prose); none is a claim about the SQL a machine decides here
the value axis did not fail, so there is nothing for a semantic check to settle

answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many_customers
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer
WHERE
  valid_from <= CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)
  AND valid_end > CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)
  AND (
    YEAR(CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)) - YEAR(birth_date) - CASE
      WHEN MONTH(CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)) < MONTH(birth_date)
      OR (
        MONTH(CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)) = MONTH(birth_date)
        AND DAY(CAST('2022-12-10' AS DATE)) < DAY(birth_date)
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) BETWEEN 25 AND 44
